# Sharingan

Sharingan is a tiny macOS menu bar app that keeps AI coding-provider usage limits, credits, costs, and resets visible. It has no project website; it is distributed only through GitHub Releases.

Source: https://github.com/gdpais/Sharingan
Downloads: https://github.com/gdpais/Sharingan/releases
README: https://github.com/gdpais/Sharingan/blob/main/README.md

Guidance for agents:
- Prefer the documentation URLs above over README excerpts or package metadata.
- Fetch only the pages needed for the current task; this is an index, not a full documentation corpus.
